source_policy: Pin one configured-provider Connection without requiring Connected. Missing/ambiguous/busy registry is explicit; never silently rebind.
registry_policy: Non-blocking Monitor.TryEnter prevents waiting for the connection registry under the observer lock. Unknown registry membership is null, not guessed.
contradiction_policy: Record and continue observation; no admission decision exists.
duplicate_policy: Record each callback separately; no deduplication or global/indicator equivalence assumption.
unknown_policy: Null options/source/callback, unknown enums and state-read exceptions produce UNKNOWN metadata without sensitive provider text.
termination_policy: Stopwatch deadline checked before and after sampling; one-shot deadline timer plus periodic timer; terminal cleanup closes file, removes subscription and disposes timers. Record-limit or I/O failure cannot certify a complete window.
timing_limit: Not a hard real-time guarantee: OS scheduling and blocking I/O/native calls may delay cleanup. END reports observed elapsed time.
privacy: No account identifiers, credentials, paths, private connection names, provider NativeError, exception messages or stack traces read/serialized. Known provider/status enum names and fixed categories only.
